title.en: California Legislature Passes SB 574 Bill on Generative AI in Legal Practice
title.zhHans: 加州立法机构通过规范法律界使用生成式 AI 的 SB 574 法案

searchSummary.en: California's Legislature completed passage of SB 574 on August 31, 2026. If enacted, the bill would set duties for attorneys and arbitrators using generative AI; it was not yet effective law in the reviewed record.
searchSummary.zhHans: 加州立法机构于 2026 年 8 月 31 日完成 SB 574 的审议通过。若获颁布，该法案将为使用生成式 AI 的律师与仲裁员设定义务；在本次审阅记录中它尚未成为生效法律。

summary.en: California's Assembly and Senate completed passage of SB 574 on August 31, 2026, and the official history records that it was ordered enrolled. The bill would prohibit delegating the practice of law to generative AI, require personally verified citations in court papers, and restrict entry of protected nonpublic information into inadequately controlled AI systems. Independent legal reporting described the measure as sent to the Governor, but the event is recorded as legislative passage, not enactment.
summary.zhHans: 加州众议院与参议院于 2026 年 8 月 31 日完成 SB 574 的审议通过，官方历史记录显示该法案已进入文书整理程序。法案若获颁布，将禁止把法律执业委托给生成式 AI，要求亲自核验法庭文书中的引文，并限制向控制不足的 AI 系统输入受保护的非公开信息。独立法律报道称该法案已送交州长，但本事件仅记录为立法通过，而非生效。

narrative.en: The bill addresses fabricated citations, confidentiality, disclosure, and arbitrator decision-making. Its provisions use prospective language because legislative approval alone does not make them enforceable. Independent legal commentary records disagreement about its scope: one expert characterized much of it as duplicative of existing ethics rules, while analysts noted unresolved boundaries around what constitutes delegating the practice of law. The policy significance is the completed legislative passage of a detailed proposal, not a claim that California had already imposed a new statewide statute.
narrative.zhHans: 该法案涉及虚构引文、保密、披露及仲裁员决策等问题。其条款均以未来时表述，因为立法通过本身并不使其可执行。独立法律评论记录了对范围的分歧：有专家认为其中大部分内容与既有伦理规则重复，分析人士则指出“委托法律执业”的边界仍未解决。其政策意义在于一项详细提案完成立法通过，而不是声称加州已经施行新的全州成文法。

description.en: If enacted, the bill would add compliance and verification duties for California legal practitioners using generative AI.
description.zhHans: 若获颁布，该法案将为使用生成式 AI 的加州法律从业者增加合规与核验义务。

description.en: Completed legislative passage puts detailed AI-use rules for legal practice into California's enactment pipeline without resolving their final legal effect.
description.zhHans: 完成立法通过使针对法律执业 AI 使用的详细规则进入加州颁布流程，但其最终法律效力尚未确定。

text.en: California's Legislature completed passage of SB 574 on August 31, 2026; the official history records it as ordered enrolled, while independent reporting described it as sent to the Governor.
text.zhHans: 加州立法机构于 2026 年 8 月 31 日完成 SB 574 的审议通过；官方历史记录其进入文书整理程序，独立报道则称其已送交州长。

text.en: If enacted, the bill would prohibit delegating the practice of law to generative AI and would require personal verification of citations in court papers.
text.zhHans: 若获颁布，该法案将禁止把法律执业委托给生成式 AI，并要求亲自核验法庭文书中的引文。

text.en: The bill was not yet effective law in the reviewed record, and independent commentary identifies disagreement over novelty and the boundary of prohibited delegation.
text.zhHans: 在本次审阅记录中，该法案尚未成为生效法律；独立评论也指出其新颖性及被禁止委托的边界存在分歧。

editorial.reviewNotes: Reviewed as legislative passage only; all substantive duties are conditional on enactment and the legal-scope debate is explicit.
